Mr. de Souza? I'm Nadia, your driver. Welcome. How was the flight?
Thank you. It was fine, but I'm tired, because it was eleven hours.
Eleven hours! Is this your first time here?
No, it isn't. I'm here two or three times a year. And you? Are you from here?
Born here. Forty minutes to the hotel, maybe fifty with the rain. Do you have family in Brazil?
Yes, two children. My son plays football and my daughter studies in another city.
Nice. Listen, the front desk asked me to tell you: the car tomorrow is at seven thirty, not at eight.
Of course. Tomorrow morning. Seven thirty, not eight. The traffic is bad after eight.
So, seven thirty, not eight. Is that right? And is there a restaurant near the hotel?
That is right. And yes — the Blue Door, two streets away, on the corner, opposite the bank.

Good evening, ladies and gentlemen, and welcome. The local time is six fifteen in the evening and the weather outside is cold, about seven degrees, with some rain. Please stay in your seat until we stop completely. Two things before you leave the aircraft. First, if this is your final destination, follow the blue signs after passport control, and your bags are on belt number four. Second, if you have a connection tonight, do not follow the blue signs. Go to the transfer desk on your right, and please go quickly, because the last flights of the evening leave in about fifty minutes. Thank you for flying with us, and have a very good evening.

Hey. So, you asked me how it went, and honestly, better than I thought. I landed at six fifteen, I found the driver, and I talked to him in the car for twenty minutes. Twenty minutes, in English, alone. Not perfect, I lost him three or four times and I asked him to repeat, and it was fine. The hotel was easy: I have a reservation, room five twelve, fifth floor, and I said the number back to be sure. At dinner I ordered for myself, the fish, and there was a woman at the next table who started talking, and I did not go quiet. I asked her where she was from. That is the part I want to tell you about. Not the words. The part where I did not go quiet.
Good evening. I have a reservation, my name is Leao de Souza. Room five twelve, fifth floor. What time is breakfast? And where is the Blue Door restaurant? Thank you very much.
